title: Scenic Sri Lanka in 9 Days: Sigiriya, Kandy, the Tea Hills, Ella, Yala and the Beaches of Bentota
meta_title: Sri Lanka 9 Days: Sigiriya, Kandy, Tea Hills, Yala, Beach
meta_description: 9-day Sri Lanka tour: Sigiriya rock, Kandy's Temple of the Tooth, Nuwara Eliya and Horton Plains, Ella, a Yala leopard safari, Galle Fort and Bentota beach.
hero_alt: Tea plantations in Sri Lanka's hill country
tagline: An ancient rock fortress, misty tea hills, leopards and golden beaches
facts: Sigiriya 1, Kandy 1, Nuwara Eliya 2, Yala 1, Bentota 2, Colombo 1
Private air-conditioned car with English-speaking driver-guide
Breakfast and dinner daily (breakfast only in Bentota and Colombo)
intro: Sri Lanka's classic circuit: the rock fortress of Sigiriya, Kandy's Temple of the Tooth, two nights in the tea hills of Nuwara Eliya with Horton Plains, the drive down through Ella to a leopard safari in Yala, Galle's Dutch fort and two beach nights at Bentota with a turtle hatchery and a river safari. The original plan arrived in Sigiriya in the evening and left the next morning without climbing the rock, so we added a 07:00 climb on day 2. Yala National Park closes for about six weeks from September; in those months we switch to Udawalawe.
highlights: The Sigiriya rock fortress at dawn
A spice garden and the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy
The Hanuman temple at Ramboda and a tea factory

faqs.q: Is it good for a honeymoon?
faqs.a: Yes. We upgrade to boutique tea-estate bungalows and a beach villa.

faqs.q: Can this itinerary be changed for our dates and pace?
faqs.a: Yes. Every Blue Diamond Voyage itinerary is a starting point. We change the number of nights, the hotels, the pace and the activities to suit your family, and send you a personalised quote.

faqs.q: Do you look after vegetarian and Jain food?
faqs.a: Yes. We send your dietary brief to every hotel and guide before you travel, and suggest pure-vegetarian restaurants along the route. Jain meals without onion, garlic and root vegetables can be arranged in most places with notice.

faqs.q: Is there support while we travel?
faqs.a: Yes. You have our 24/7 travel desk on +91 97148 59797 and +91 98242 21400 and a WhatsApp group with your consultant for the whole trip.

good_to_know.title: Hotel deposit
good_to_know.text: Use a credit card for the deposit or pre-authorisation at check-in, never a forex or debit card. Forex cards cannot hold funds, many hotels refuse them, and a credit-card hold is released faster.

good_to_know.title: Rupees
good_to_know.text: Sri Lankan rupees (LKR). Cards work in hotels and big shops; carry cash for temples, tuk-tuks and roadside stalls. Indian rupees are not accepted.

good_to_know.title: Temples
good_to_know.text: Remove shoes and hats, cover shoulders and knees, and never pose for a photo with your back to a Buddha statue. White clothing is preferred at the Temple of the Tooth. Some Hindu kovils ask men to remove shirts.

good_to_know.title: Hill country
good_to_know.text: Nuwara Eliya is about 15°C and can drop to 5°C at night. Pack a warm layer and a rain jacket.

dining_intro: Sri Lanka is very easy for Indian vegetarians: rice and curry with dal, vegetables and sambols is served everywhere, and Colombo, Kandy and Nuwara Eliya have Indian vegetarian restaurants. Hotels cook Jain food with notice.
dining_avoid: Many curries and sambols use Maldive fish flakes or dried shrimp. Ask for 'no Maldive fish' and say 'vegetarian, no egg'.
